meta.title: Score a vendor with an Evaluation Matrix

args.goal: Open the Vendors tab, open the vendor profile with an onboarding response, open Onboarding Details, click Start Evaluation, select the relevant existing evaluation matrix from Evaluation Matrix Type, enter a response and assign a score for every question in all sections that appear, and stop on the evaluation screen showing the rendered sections, questions, responses, and scores.

steps.note: Performs the vendor onboarding evaluation flow that has no dedicated catalog step and requires interacting with the matrix-specific screen.
Confirms the evaluation screen remains rendered with the matrix selector after the matrix and scoring flow.
